sources.title: The Art of Mathematics: Coffee Time in Memphis
sources.claim_consumed: line-by-line reconstruction of Lassak's cap-plus-orthant proof
sources.provenance_note: In the Borsuk solution, Bollobás explicitly states that the proof presented for the Lassak bound is exactly Lassak's proof. This secondary was used for proof details because the official primary full text is remotely restricted.

sources.title: Reducing the upper bound for the Borsuk number in R^4 to 8

project_internal_sources.claim_consumed: dated status 7<=b(6)<=33 and permission to attack the external Euclidean upper-bound gap
project_internal_sources.guard: Consumed only as accepted project state; it does not prove the new GEO8 obstruction.

source_strength_guard: The R4 result remains a preprint and is not promoted to peer-reviewed status.
The exact new K_33 incompatibility theorem is project-local and receives no historical novelty claim.
No claim is made that the remotely inaccessible primary Lassak PDF was read.

The reconstruction is triangulated from verified primary metadata, the 2026 primary preprint's general-dimensional Lassak restatement, and a reliable secondary that explicitly says it reproduces Lassak's proof exactly.
